title: leptorkis lutea
intro: Leptorkis lutea, commonly known as Tiger Balm plant or Acmos, is a species of flowering plant in the family Zingiberaceae, native to Southeast Asia. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The health benefits of Leptorkis lutea include reducing fever, relieving muscle and joint pain, and promoting digestion, while its therapeutic actions involve anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Leptorkis lutea include gingerol, shogaol, and zingiberene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
